title: Day 0 - Made a Promise
text:
“Nobody is going to look at my resume and just give me a job. There’s no way! I have to stand out.”
I said that to myself in the mirror this morning. It made me realize the truth.
Obviously, no one’s coming to save me.
No recruiter is going to slide into my inbox. Or will they? No clue And definitely I am not some god coder.
But I am just a guy who still wants to fight.

title: Day 0 - Made a Promise
text:
The Promise
So I said to myself that for the next 30 days, I am going to show up no matter what.
30 days. No excuses. Just show up.
Every single day, I said I will: - Learn something hard - Build something real - Write about it - Share the journey
Just showing up every. single. day.

title: Day 0 - Made a Promise
section: Why did I call it “30 Days of Hell Out There”?
text:
Why did I call it “30 Days of Hell Out There”?
Because honestly, it feels like hell right now. Very uncertain. Feeling lost

Not knowing where I stand

Feeling like I am falling behind

Waking up anxious

This blog — this whole series — is me swinging back.
Just wanted to document everything.

title: Day 0 - Made a Promise
text:
Inspired by the KING
It’s inspired by Virat Kohli — not just for the records, but for the mindset.

Ruthless discipline

Showing up when no one’s watching

Grinding when it’s hard

And proving yourself over and over again

That’s what I’m trying to tap into.

title: Day 0 - Made a Promise
text:
This is Day 0
No fake positivity.
No “I’ve got this” energy.
Just real. Just effort.
Just me, showing up.
Let’s see where this goes.

PS: I am going to try to keep it as raw as possible just my initial thoughts and not focusing on the actual quality of the formatting. I used GPT for this day 0, but going forward, hopefully raw. Thanks for reading! Let’s get it!
